```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library("optparse")
library("ggplot2")
library("reshape")
require("gridExtra")
library("ggpubr")
library("ggh4x")
library("dplyr")
library("rstatix")
library("vegan")
library("ggordiplots")
```

# Spider PCoA 
## Beta diversity contrasting Ponds
### pc1 vs pc2
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Input table and metadata
beta_data <- read.table(file = "./unweighted_unifrac_dm_maz-est.tsv",
                        sep="\t",
                        header=T,
                        row.names=1,
                        check.names=F)

metadata <- read.table(file = "./metadata_maz-est.tsv",
                       sep="\t",
                       header=T,
                       row.names=1,
                       check.names=F)

# metadata <- metadata %>% filter(!grepl("Pond C", Pond))


metadata <- metadata %>% mutate(Pond = factor(Pond,
                                                            levels=c(
                                                              "Pond A",
                                                              "Pond B")))

# Define colors
colors <- c( "royalblue",
             "darkgreen")

# Define shapes
shapes <- c(15, 16)

# PCoA plot
theme_set(theme_bw())
ord <- cmdscale(beta_data,
                eig = T,
                x.ret = TRUE,
                k=ncol(beta_data)-1)

# ord$points[,1] <- -ord$points[,1]
ord$points[,2] <- -ord$points[,2]

plt <- gg_ordiplot(ord,
                   choices = c(2, 1),
                   groups = metadata$Pond,
                   conf = 0.95,
                   spiders = TRUE,
                   plot = FALSE,
                   ellipse = FALSE,
                   pt.size = 1,
                   scaling = 1)

plt <- plt$plot +
  geom_point(data = plt$df_ord,
             aes(x = x, y = y, color = Group, shape = Group),
             size = 2) +

scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
scale_shape_manual(values = shapes) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
labs(
  x="PC1 (29.75%)",
  y="PC2 (17.44%)",
    subtitle = "ANOSIM=0.074; p-value=0.084",
    title = "") +
geom_hline(yintercept=0,
    color = "gray") +
geom_vline(xintercept=0,
    color = "gray") +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = c(0.5, 1.1),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(size=12),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=12),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size=12),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size=12),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                     vjust = -1))

plt
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Creation of .tiff
ggsave("./pond_maz-est_pc1-pc2_spider.tiff",
       width=5,
       height=5,
       dpi=300,
       device="tiff")

dev.off()
```
\newpage

### pc1 vs pc3
```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

ord <- cmdscale(beta_data,
                eig = T,
                x.ret = TRUE,

ord$points[,2] <- -ord$points[,2]

plt <- gg_ordiplot(ord,
                   choices = c(1, 3),
                   groups = metadata$Pond,
                   conf = 0.95,
                   spiders = TRUE,
                   plot = FALSE,
                   ellipse = FALSE,

                   scaling = 1)

plt <- plt$plot +

scale_color_manual(values = colors) +

  x="PC1 (29.75%)",

geom_hline(yintercept=0,
    color = "gray") +
```
